query: For a 63‑year‑old female: among patients aged 58–68 admitted with chest pain or AMI whose first Troponin T >0.01 ng/mL, report Troponin T distribution (mean, SD, min–max).
final_sql: SELECT p.gender, AVG(l.value) AS average_troponin_t, STDDEV(l.value) AS standard_deviation_troponin_t, MIN(l.value) AS minimum_troponin_t, MAX(l.value) AS maximum_troponin_t FROM patients p JOIN admissions a ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id JOIN labevents l ON a.subject_id = l.subject_id AND a.hadm_id = l.hadm_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(CURRENT_DATE, p.dob)) = 63 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.admittime) BETWEEN 2018 AND 2020 AND l.itemid = 817981 AND l.value > 0.01 GROUP BY p.gender ORDER BY average_troponin_t NULLS LAST;
